title: What the ZCC Terraform provider covers, and what it leaves to the console

prose.text: The list of resources and data sources is generated: run `node scripts/kb.mjs surface zcc` and read the `terraform` entries. This subject holds why some configuration has no resource and what the notification resource does and does not manage.

prose.label: Public API only.
prose.text: {{api-parity}} {{no-terraform-resource}} {{no-entitlement-resource}} The web policy API itself is [[zcc.api.web-policy-wire]].

prose.label: Notification templates.
prose.text: {{notification-template-scope}} The acceptable use policy is a separate setting, described in [[zcc.acceptable-use]], and the generated resource list (`node scripts/kb.mjs surface zcc`) has no AUP resource.

checks.do: Whether the setting is exposed by the public API at all before looking for a provider resource for it.

api-parity.statement: The provider documentation says it keeps parity with the publicly available API endpoints and implements only what that API exposes, so a setting available in the console but not through the API cannot be in the provider.

quotes: The ZCC Terraform provider maintains parity with publicly available API endpoints.
we implement only the features that are currently exposed by the public API.

notification-template-scope.statement: `zcc_notification_template` manages a notification template through `/zcc/papi/public/v2/notification-templates`: which end-user notifications Client Connector raises (application updates, service-status changes, ZIA firewall, DNS and IPS blocks, ZPA reauthentication prompts and posture-failure messages). The per-service toggles are the single nested attributes `zia_notification_template` and `zpa_notification_template`, written `zia_notification_template = { ... }`; the documentation calls them nested blocks while its own example uses `=`.
notification-template-scope.conditions: Corrected 'nested ZIA and ZPA blocks': the schema declares them as SingleNestedAttribute, so they take `=`. Added the SDK's endpoint constant as the path's source.

quotes: A notification template controls which end-user notifications the Client Connector raises on the endpoint — application updates, service-status changes, ZIA firewall/DNS/IPS blocks, ZPA reauthentication prompts, and posture-failure messages.
Per-service toggles live under the two nested blocks `zia_notification_template` and `zpa_notification_template`.

no-terraform-resource.statement: The ZCC Terraform provider registers no resource or data source for app profiles or web policies: the per-OS app profile resources and the application profiles data source are intentionally deregistered.
no-terraform-resource.conditions: Upgraded from Tier B: the provider's CLAUDE.md states the deregistration. Absence: the provider's resource and data source registrations and the files under internal/framework were searched at the pin for web policy or app profile; none found.

quotes: The per-OS `zcc_app_profile_*` resources (`macos`, `ios`, `windows`, `linux`, `android`) and the `zcc_application_profiles` data source are **intentionally deregistered**.
### 3. Web policy / app_profile family (parked — DO NOT re-register without sign-off)

no-entitlement-resource.statement: The ZCC Terraform provider registers no resource or data source for entitlements.
no-entitlement-resource.conditions: Moved from zcc.entitlements.api:no-terraform-resource (renamed: the ID collides with the app profile claim here). Absence: the provider's resource and data source registrations were searched at the pin for entitlement; none found.
